title: Beta Revived
description: A nostalgic overhaul that makes Minecraft 1.21.11 feel like Beta 1.7.3.
body:
## **🌲 Features**
🌫️ Classic Beta Atmosphere
Old fog, lighting, and color tones recreated
## 
## **🌍 Retro World Generation**
Terrain inspired by Beta 1.7.3 (hills, beaches, caves)
## 
## **🎮 Old Gameplay Feel**
Slower progression, less hand-holding, more survival

## **🎵 Nostalgic Audio**
Classic-style ambient sounds and music vibes

# 📦 Recommended Settings
Render Distance: 6–10 chunks
Brightness: Moody (for best beta feel)
Turn off shaders for authentic experience

💬 Join / Support
If you enjoy the pack, consider supporting or sharing it!
Feedback is always welcome.
